attack_techniques: Boot or Logon Autostart Execution: Shortcut Modification (T1547.009)
attackers_goals: Modify or create a shortcut to gain code or program execution.
description: An attacker may embed a .LNK file in an Office document to execute malicious code.
investigative_actions: Check if the Office document contains a shortcut object. Check the content (strings) of the document object for a .LNK shortcut. Check the content of the shortcut.
name: Office process accessed an unusual .LNK file
required_data: XDR Agent with eXtended Threat Hunting (XTH)
